crypto_headlines.title: Vitalik argues ETH should be valued as a store of value, not a fee-burn token
crypto_headlines.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin wrote that focusing on ETH as a store of value makes more sense than treating it as a fee-burning token, saying the burn case was never as strong as it seemed and that optimizing for burns could pressure decentralization. He used a present-day market-cap figure of about $270 billion in the thread.

crypto_headlines.title: Hyperliquid whales flip from long to short on Bitcoin after seven months
crypto_headlines.summary: Cointelegraph, citing Glassnode, reported that Hyperliquid whales have flipped from long to short on Bitcoin after seven months, with short exposure at its highest level since October 2025.

crypto_headlines.title: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $1.28B in weekly outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: Farside's weekly summary put net U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF flow at -$1,281.7 million, led by BlackRock's IBIT at -$1,209.5 million, while Fidelity's FBTC took in $93.1 million. Friday alone was -$411.9 million, with IBIT at -$403 million and FBTC at +$42.8 million.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot ether ETFs lost $93.3M on Friday, led by BlackRock's ETHA
crypto_headlines.summary: Farside reported Friday, Nov. 6 net flow for U.S. spot ether ETFs at -$93.3 million, including -$90.8 million from BlackRock's ETHA.

crypto_headlines.title: Altcoins have shed about $200B, with most Binance names under their 200-day average
crypto_headlines.summary: Cointelegraph reported that altcoins have lost roughly $200 billion in market capitalization, with 70% of Binance-listed altcoins now trading below their 200-day moving average, according to a CryptoQuant analyst.

crypto_headlines.title: New wallet opens a 20x Bitcoin long and ether short on Hyperliquid
crypto_headlines.summary: Lookonchain said a newly created wallet received 3,100 ETH from Tornado Cash, sold it for $6.92 million USDC, deposited the funds into Hyperliquid, then opened a 20x long on 169.47 BTC (about $12.84 million) and a 20x short on 5,740 ETH (about $12.83 million).

doginal_news.title: Official account: DDMIAMI 2026 is in 30 days
doginal_news.summary: Doginal Dogs posted that DDMIAMI 2026 is 30 days away and linked to the event page at doginaldogs.com.

doginal_news.title: Floor still 47k DOGE with zero listings after Saturday
doginal_news.summary: Community tracker BradX's Saturday night check said the floor stayed at 47k DOGE with nothing listed after a full weekend day, and that there have been no new fills since dog #495 at 115k DOGE on Tuesday.

doginal_news.title: CrashMetaX takes Legends cards to a show and hands some to kids
doginal_news.summary: Community member CrashMetaX posted from a card show featuring TGA and The GOAT, said he handed out stickers, business cards, Doginal Dogs cards, and sleeved DDLTCG cards (including to kids), and that he plans to return in April.

doginal_news.title: PIRB: got GTA VI before everyone, courier is Pyth Network
doginal_news.summary: Pyth's community account posted a meme saying it got GTA VI before everyone and that its courier is @PythNetwork.

notes: No new original posts from @DDLTCG or @PythNetwork in the last ~24 hours. No news on Toot, Atlas, or Boogie. Floor note is community tracking, not an official listing figure. CrashMetaX's details about handing out cards come from his own follow-up replies to the linked show post.
